column1: # Expected verdicts of the tree query's rule-stack test (run_tree_rules.py).
# One query per line: the index (idx, or a variant of it lacking what an older
# uniqsketch did not write), the read file(s) under reads/ ('+' joins two files),
# extra querysketch options, the exit status, and the rows of the result table.
# rows: name:resolution[:members], comma-separated, compared as a set (the table
# is ordered by count, and rows with equal counts have no defined order). '-' is
# an empty table, '*' is not compared (no table is expected), '=ID' means
# byte-for-byte the table of case ID. Counts and abundances are not listed here:
# the checks that bound them are in run_tree_rules.py, next to the stderr
# evidence that the rule named in the last column is what produced the rows.
# A change to a rule of the query is expected to change lines of this file, and
# only lines whose last column names that rule. KNOWN marks behaviour recorded as

column7: pins
settlement: a carrier excluded on its own loci and an untestable one with a silent lineage are absent; a resolved member that carries the node's signatures suppresses the family row
carried signatures join the node when every carrier is absent: family row for a member without signatures; the enclosing level-0 row is dropped (nested)
settlement: at 3x no carrier can be excluded, the carried signatures are set aside and the call falls back to the parent
untestable carrier: a sibling without signatures puts no row on the node it is not in
carrier seen on its own signatures: what it carries is set aside, no row on the sibling node
family row beside a resolved member that cannot account for the node's hits. KNOWN: the level-1 row is withheld by the family breadth floor (0.215), judged against signatures that were set aside
carrier attested by its own lineage: what it carries is set aside, no row on node X
rejoin: a node pruned at level 0 is scored on its own evidence
nested suppression: the level-0 row is dropped for its level-1 sub-group
leaf rescue on its own global signatures after its lineage was pruned
three nested family calls: the finest is kept
within-group signatures admitted when no carrier may be present
within-group mask: the carrier is present, the signatures are withheld, family row instead
within-group mask: the carrier alone does not light the leaf
strain breadth floor: one locus at depth is withheld
family breadth floor: one locus at depth is withheld
KNOWN: a strain called on one read (lineage attested) suppresses its family's 269-read row
one read on a leaf whose lineage is not attested is not a call
two reads rescue a leaf whose lineage is not attested
an organism outside the index: empty table
two read files give the table one file gives
abundance follows coverage (20:10:5:5)
leaf rescue on within-group signatures nobody else carries
a resolved member that carries what the node's hits show suppresses the family row, a hidden sibling or not
gzip reads give the table plain reads give
KNOWN: a one-read rescue (lineage attested by the rejoined node) suppresses the rejoined family row
one unattested read beside a dominant unrelated genome is not a call
two unrelated family rows are both kept
carrier exclusion constant: at 12x a two-locus carrier expects 11 reads (excluded), a one-locus carrier 5.6 (possible)
permissive pruning: three hits on a node keep its leaves in play, and a leaf with within-group signatures only is reported through its lineage
hit threshold: a member in play with five hits is not a strain row and does not suppress its family
rejoin needs two reads: one read clearing the hit threshold on a pruned node is not a family row
family beside a resolved member needs the excess margin: about 45 node signatures hit beyond the 615 the member carries are not enough
a carrier is present on one read of its own signatures: what it carries is set aside. KNOWN: single-read strain row beside the family; level-1 row withheld as in S06
KNOWN: one read makes a family row when the node was not pruned above (its level-0 node has a few hits from the same read); compare S32, where the node was pruned and one read is not enough
the two mates of one fragment count as two reads: they rescue a leaf whose lineage is not attested (compare S18, S19)
KNOWN: a hidden sibling at three times the resolved member's depth leaves no row: the family is suppressed while the member carries the signatures hit, whatever the depth
KNOWN: a leaf rescued on one read counts its lineage as attested by a node whose evidence is another, resolved member's (node R is lit by B1's reads, which A1's genome cannot produce)

KNOWN: a leaf kept by the narrowing is a strain row on one read whether or not its lineage is attested (one other read keeps node B in play without attesting it); compare S18, where the leaf was pruned and one read is not enough

the thread count does not change the table
